task_description: Implement the Character Assistant feature per the approved design: a pure deterministic suggestion engine behind a SuggestionSource interface, a provider/hook + app-shell wiring mirroring the command palette, a persistent badge-bearing trigger in Navigation (desktop + mobile), a drawer/bottom-sheet panel with grouping/urgency ordering and dismiss/snooze, Tooltip breakdowns for calculated totals, and a test suite (fast-check property tests for the engine; component tests for panel + trigger asserting no auto-apply / no character mutation). Additive; existing tests stay green; no worktree; all four gates (tsc, build, vitest, eslint) clean.
